Service Law: c Subsistence Allowance - Non-payment of - On the ground that delinquent did not stay at head-quarters during departmental proceedings - Propriety of - Held: Suspended employee is entitled to subsistence allowance - In the instant case, there is no rule providing for presence of the subsistence D allowance - Direction to release the subsistence allowance.
